description: Sample player with a slicing grid — it plays a loaded sample from a trigger, from a gate, or one slice at a time

params.text: Sets how many slices the sample is cut into, 1 to 128
Steps through the three ways playing is started: a trigger that plays the sample through, a gate that plays only while it is held, and slice mode, where each trigger plays the next slice
Steps through the three ways a slice is read: forwards, backwards, and repeating
Sets how fast the sample is read, from a little below a standstill to ten times, and the pitch rises with it
Attenuverts the slice-count voltage before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1
Attenuverts the speed voltage before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1

inputs.text: Starts playing; in gate mode the sample plays for as long as the voltage is held
Sets the play head position; on trigger and slice modes it sets where a trigger starts from, and on gate mode it moves the head freely through the sample
Adds to the number of slices, scaled by its attenuverter
Steps the slice reading mode on, scaled to the three modes
Adds to the speed, scaled by its attenuverter
A trigger here sends the play head back to the start of the sample

outputs.text: The left channel of the sample being played
The right channel of the sample being played
A 10V pulse when the sample or slice reaches its end

notes: nothing plays until a sample is loaded: choose Load sample from the right-click menu, or drop a wav or aiff file onto the panel
the display draws the waveform with the slice markers across it; drag up and down on it to zoom and sideways to scroll, and hold shift while dragging to zoom faster
menu: Load sample — opens a wav or aiff file and loads it as the sample

inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
